value: Statutory Provisions Regulating the Relationship between the Lessor and the Lessee (Royal Decree), published by REGA; status shown on the page: active.
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia

value: The lessor may not increase the total rent in lease contracts in force when the provisions entered into force or concluded after (clause Second(1)). A vacant property previously leased may not exceed the total rent of its most recent lease (clause Second(2)); a never-leased property is priced as agreed (clause Second(3)).
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia

value: Clauses Second to Fourth apply for five years from entry into force (clause Fifth) and only to real property in the city of Riyadh (clause Sixth(1)); the Authority may extend them to other cities or parts under the procedure in clause Sixth(2).
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia

value: If the lessee wishes to renew, the lessor may refuse only for non-payment, structural defects affecting safety (technical report), the lessor's wish to recover a residential property for personal or first-degree relative use, or other cases set by the Authority (clause Fourth).
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia

value: For a lease not registered in the Ejar network the lessor must apply to register it; the lessee may also request registration; the other party may object within 60 days of notification, otherwise the contract data is deemed correct (clause Seventh).
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia

value: A lease renews automatically unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the term, with listed exceptions (clause Eighth(1)).
source_publisher: Real Estate General Authority (REGA), Saudi Arabia
